symbols.name: G
symbols.def: a directed acyclic graph on the vertices indexed by \(H\) and \(X\)

symbols.name: \(\Lambda\)
symbols.def: the edges of \(G\) whose endpoints are both latent

symbols.name: s
symbols.def: \(s(a,k)\) is the \(k\)-th row of \(S_a\) in order \(\rho_a\)

symbols.name: M
symbols.def: \(M_a(x,h)=P(X_{S_a}=x\mid H=h)\), with rows and columns lexicographically ordered by \(\rho_a\)

symbols.name: \(\varepsilon_{q,K}\)
symbols.def: the sign induced by the fixed lexicographic conventions

symbols.name: \(\Theta_{\Gamma,\Lambda}^{+}\)
symbols.role: strictly positive categorical-table domain constructed in Definition 4

symbols.name: \(N_{\mathrm{DT}}\)
symbols.def: the numerator obtained after writing \(\Delta_{\mathrm{DT}}\) over the positive conditioning-probability denominators on \(\Theta_{\Gamma,\Lambda}^{+}\)

symbols.name: \(\eta\)
symbols.def: \(\eta=(\eta_{a,k,u}:a\in\{1,2\},k\le K,u\in\mathcal Q^{k-1})\) with every entry positive and sufficiently small

symbols.name: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{DT}}^{(q)}(K,J)\)
symbols.role: categorical double-triangular class constructed in Definition 1

symbols.name: \(K_{\min}\)
symbols.def: \(K_{\min}(P_X)=\min\{L:P_X\text{ has a }q\text{-state measurement-model realization with }L\text{ latent coordinates}\}\)

symbols.name: \(\sim\)
symbols.def: two realizations are equivalent when related by \(\mathfrak G\) and their latent DAGs are Markov equivalent

symbols.name: \(\mathcal C_K(P_X)\)
symbols.role: fully specified same-dimension comparison domain constructed in Definition 6

symbols.name: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{Chen}}\)
symbols.type: class of mixed-type latent structure models
symbols.def: the class in Chen et al. (2025) satisfying completeness, nondegeneracy, their two-sufficient-measurement condition, and their support-identification condition

symbols.name: \(\mathsf H_q\)
symbols.def: recursive enumeration of disjoint \(K\)-row views, pruning by observable unfolding ranks and recovered local-minor patterns, followed by finite component-partition refinement and latent conditional-independence queries
symbols.role: starting move for a recovery algorithm

symbols.name: \(A_q\)
symbols.role: sound-and-complete reconstruction algorithm to be derived

symbols.name: \(b^{\star}\)
symbols.def: \(b^{\star}_{j,u}(x)=\frac13+\sum_{m\in\operatorname{pred}(j)}c^{\star}_{jm}(\mathbf1\{x=u_m\}-\frac13)\), where \(\operatorname{pred}(j)\) is the set of parents preceding the diagonal parent in the selected triangular order
symbols.role: context-specific base columns of the witness matrices

symbols.name: n
symbols.role: sample size for the consumer rung

symbols.name: \(\widehat\Phi_n\)
symbols.def: the studentized local-minor and smallest-singular-value residuals along the query sequence of \(\mathsf H_q\) applied to \(\widehat P_n\)

symbols.name: \(q_{\mathrm{bin}}\)
symbols.role: cardinality in the separately typed Lee--Gu binary comparator

symbols.name: \(G_{\mathrm{bin}}\)
symbols.def: a directed acyclic graph on the vertices indexed by \(H_{\mathrm{bin}}\) and \(X_{\mathrm{bin}}\)

symbols.name: \(\Lambda_{\mathrm{bin}}\)
symbols.def: the edges of \(G_{\mathrm{bin}}\) whose endpoints are both latent

symbols.name: \(s_{\mathrm{bin}}\)
symbols.def: \(s_{\mathrm{bin}}(a,k)\) is the \(k\)-th selected binary row in the order \((\rho_{\mathrm{bin}})_a\)
symbols.role: selected rows in the binary comparator

symbols.name: \((K_{\min})_{\mathrm{bin}}\)
symbols.def: \((K_{\min})_{\mathrm{bin}}((P_X)_{\mathrm{bin}})=\min\{L:(P_X)_{\mathrm{bin}}\text{ has a binary measurement-model realization with }L\text{ latent coordinates}\}\)

symbols.name: \(\mathscr L(P_X)\)
symbols.def: the \(q^K\) component-label set identified up to an arbitrary permutation by a three-view decomposition of the observed tensor for \((S_1,S_2,S_3)\)
symbols.role: unstructured mixture labels before coordinate alignment

symbols.name: \(\mathcal E(P_X)\)
symbols.def: for each observed coordinate \(j\), labels \(\ell,\ell'\in\mathscr L(P_X)\) satisfy \(\ell\mathrel{E_j}\ell'\) exactly when the recovered conditional distributions of \(X_j\) in components \(\ell\) and \(\ell'\) coincide
symbols.role: observable component-equality pattern used for coordinate alignment

assumptions.condition: The graph \(G\) has no edge between observed vertices and no edge from an observed vertex to a latent vertex.
The conditional-independence relations of \(P(H,X)\) equal the d-separation relations of \(G\).
Every entry of every latent conditional table and every measurement conditional table compatible with \(\Lambda\) and \(\Gamma\) is strictly positive.
For every observed coordinate \(j\), distinct configurations of \(H_{\operatorname{pa}_{\Gamma}(j)}\) induce distinct conditional distributions of \(X_j\).

There exist disjoint row sets \(S_1,S_2\) and orders \(\rho_1,\rho_2\) such that \(\Gamma_{s(a,k),\rho_a(k)}=1\) and \(\Gamma_{s(a,k),\rho_a(\ell)}=0\) for every \(a\in\{1,2\}\), \(k\in\{1,\ldots,K\}\), and \(\ell>k\).

novel.justification: This is a categorical graph condition: it permits each selected item to depend on its diagonal latent state and arbitrary earlier categorical states, so it is not inherited from a binary scalar-contrast theorem. Polytomous skill batteries with two ordered prerequisite-sensitive item blocks satisfy it even when no block is pure; the eight-row ternary graph \(\Gamma^{\star}\) is an explicit dense example.

assumptions.condition: Every latent coordinate has at least one observed child indexed by \(S_3\).
For distinct \(k,\ell\), neither \(\operatorname{ch}_X(H_k)\) nor \(\operatorname{ch}_X(H_\ell)\) contains the other.

novel.justification: The condition consists of finitely many strict context-specific categorical contrasts. On every fixed double-triangular graph, the explicit diagonal-dominant family has local determinants \(\eta_{a,k,u}^{q-1}\), so the nonvanishing locus is a nonempty relatively open dense, full-measure subset of the positive categorical-table parameter space. Such contrasts can be checked in polytomous cognitive-diagnosis designs without pure children.

assumptions.condition: The graph \(G_{\mathrm{bin}}\) has no edge between binary observed vertices and no edge from a binary observed vertex to a binary latent vertex.
For every binary observed coordinate \(j\), distinct configurations of its latent parents induce distinct conditional distributions of \((X_{\mathrm{bin}})_j\).

There exist disjoint ordered row sets \((S_1)_{\mathrm{bin}},(S_2)_{\mathrm{bin}}\) and orders \(\rho_{\mathrm{bin}}\) such that \((\Gamma_{\mathrm{bin}})_{s_{\mathrm{bin}}(a,k),(\rho_{\mathrm{bin}})_a(k)}=1\) and \((\Gamma_{\mathrm{bin}})_{s_{\mathrm{bin}}(a,k),(\rho_{\mathrm{bin}})_a(\ell)}=0\) for every \(a\in\{1,2\}\), \(k\in\{1,\ldots,K\}\), and \(\ell>k\).
The conditional-independence relations of \(P_{\mathrm{bin}}\) equal the d-separation relations of \(G_{\mathrm{bin}}\).
Every binary latent coordinate has at least one observed child indexed by \((S_3)_{\mathrm{bin}}\).
For distinct \(k,\ell\), neither \(\operatorname{ch}_{X_{\mathrm{bin}}}((H_{\mathrm{bin}})_k)\) nor \(\operatorname{ch}_{X_{\mathrm{bin}}}((H_{\mathrm{bin}})_\ell)\) contains the other.

definitions.name: \(q\)-state double-triangular latent causal measurement class \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{DT}}^{(q)}(K,J)\)
definitions.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{DT}}^{(q)}(K,J)=\{(G,P): (G,P)\text{ satisfies the measurement-graph, Markov, faithfulness, positive-latent-support, measurement-nondegeneracy, categorical double-triangular, third-view-coverage, and subset conditions for fixed }q,K,J\}\).

definitions.name: local-minor family
definitions.construction: Form \(B_{a,k,u}\) from the selected triangular row and set \(d_{a,k,u}=\det(B_{a,k,u})\) for every \(a,k,u\).

definitions.name: positive categorical-table parameter space \(\Theta_{\Gamma,\Lambda}^{+}\)
definitions.construction: \(\Theta_{\Gamma,\Lambda}^{+}=\{\theta:\theta\text{ consists of all latent and measurement conditional-table entries for the fixed graphs }\Lambda,\Gamma;\ \theta\text{ obeys the simplex constraints and Assumptions 2 and 5}\}\).

definitions.name: explicit nonvanishing family
definitions.construction: Set the latent coordinates independent and uniform. For each selected row and predecessor context choose a strictly positive probability vector \(b_{a,k,u}\) and set \(B_{a,k,u}=b_{a,k,u}\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+\eta_{a,k,u}Q_q\), with \(\eta_{a,k,u}>0\) small enough for strict positivity; assign arbitrary strictly positive tables to unselected observed rows. Then \(\det(B_{a,k,u})=\eta_{a,k,u}^{q-1}\).

definitions.name: same-dimension BLCM domain \(\mathcal C_K(P_X)\)
definitions.construction: \(\mathcal C_K(P_X)=\{(G',P',\Gamma',\Lambda',\pi',p'):\ H'\in\mathcal Q^K,\ X\in\mathcal Q^J;\ G'\text{ is a DAG with latent-to-latent and latent-to-observed edges only};\ P'\text{ factorizes over }G';\ P'(H'=h)>0\text{ for every }h;\ P'\text{ is faithful to }G';\text{ distinct configurations of }H'_{\operatorname{pa}_{\Gamma'}(j)}\text{ give distinct laws of }X_j\text{ for every }j;\text{ no two latent observed-child sets contain one another};\ \sum_hP'(X=x,H'=h)=P_X(x)\text{ for every }x\in\mathcal Q^J\}\). Neither double triangularity, the certificate, third-view coverage, nor knowledge of \(S_1,S_2\) is imposed on an alternative realization.

definitions.name: quotient recovery target
definitions.construction: \(\mathcal R(P_X)=[\Gamma,\pi,p,[\Lambda]_{\mathrm{MEC}}]_{\sim}\), where \(\sim\) quotients coordinate relabeling, within-coordinate state relabeling, and latent Markov equivalence.

definitions.name: local-query recovery handle \(\mathsf H_q\)
definitions.construction: Start from \(\mathsf H_q\): enumerate candidate disjoint \(K\)-row views; prune by exact observable unfolding ranks and induced local-minor vanishing patterns; recover only an unstructured \(q^K\)-label mixture by three-view decomposition; apply the component-equality pattern \(\mathcal E(P_X)\) to align those labels with \(K\) categorical coordinates; then reconstruct \(\pi\), the measurement tables, and latent conditional independences. Order branches by the number of unclassified observed rows and then the number of unresolved component pairs, using that lexicographic pair as the decreasing termination measure.

definitions.name: dense ternary witness with displayed selected matrices
definitions.construction: Take \(q=3\), \(K=3\), \(J=8\), \(S_1=(1,2,3)\), \(S_2=(4,5,6)\), \(S_3=(7,8)\), \(\rho_1=(1,2,3)\), \(\rho_2=(2,1,3)\), graph \(\Gamma^{\star}\), the empty latent DAG, and law \(P^{\star}\). With \(Q_3=I_3-\mathbf1\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}/3\), the six selected matrices are \(B_{1,1,\varnothing}=\frac13\mathbf1\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+c^{\star}_{11}Q_3\), \(B_{1,2,(u_1)}=b^{\star}_{2,(u_1)}\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+c^{\star}_{22}Q_3\), \(B_{1,3,(u_1,u_2)}=b^{\star}_{3,(u_1,u_2)}\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+c^{\star}_{33}Q_3\), \(B_{2,1,\varnothing}=\frac13\mathbf1\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+c^{\star}_{42}Q_3\), \(B_{2,2,(u_2)}=b^{\star}_{5,(u_2)}\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+c^{\star}_{51}Q_3\), and \(B_{2,3,(u_2,u_1)}=b^{\star}_{6,(u_2,u_1)}\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}+c^{\star}_{63}Q_3\), for every displayed predecessor context.

definitions.name: empirical certificate handle
definitions.construction: Compute \(\widehat\Phi_n\) along the finite query path of \(\mathsf H_q\), studentize each smooth local minor away from singular intersections, and calibrate the maximum over the complete query family by a multinomial multiplier bootstrap with a separate smallest-singular-value branch at singular points.

definitions.name: Lee--Gu binary rank comparator class \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{LG},1}^{\mathrm{bin}}(K,J)\)
definitions.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{LG},1}^{\mathrm{bin}}(K,J)=\{(G_{\mathrm{bin}},P_{\mathrm{bin}}):q_{\mathrm{bin}}=2,\ H_{\mathrm{bin}}\in\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{bin}}^K,\ X_{\mathrm{bin}}\in\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{bin}}^J,\text{ and the binary measurement-graph, Markov, positive-latent-support, measurement-nondegeneracy, and double-triangular conditions hold}\}\).

definitions.name: Lee--Gu binary identification comparator class \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{LG},2}^{\mathrm{bin}}(K,J)\)
definitions.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{LG},2}^{\mathrm{bin}}(K,J)=\{(G_{\mathrm{bin}},P_{\mathrm{bin}})\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{LG},1}^{\mathrm{bin}}(K,J):\text{ the binary faithfulness, third-view-coverage, and subset conditions hold}\}\).

definitions.name: component-equality coordinate-alignment pattern
definitions.construction: Recover the unstructured label set \(\mathscr L(P_X)\) by three-view decomposition and set \(\mathcal E(P_X)=\{E_j:1\le j\le J\}\), where \(\ell\mathrel{E_j}\ell'\) if and only if the recovered conditional columns for \(X_j\) agree at labels \(\ell\) and \(\ell'\); order intersections and refinements of these equality relations by observed-child-set inclusion.

statements.statement: For each \(a\in\{1,2\}\), every \(q\)-state triangular view satisfying the Markov factorization obeys \(\det(M_a)=\varepsilon_{q,K}\prod_{k=1}^K\prod_{u\in\mathcal Q^{k-1}}\det(B_{a,k,u})^{q^{K-k}}=\varepsilon_{q,K}\Delta_a\).
statements.justification: The factorization exposes every load-bearing categorical contrast rather than hiding failure in a global generic-rank condition.
statements.gap: Lee and Gu (2026, Appendix D and Appendix G) prove a binary recursion and display a ternary obstruction, but do not give the all-\(q\), all-context product.
statements.consumer: It gives a finite symbolic certificate for proposed polytomous cognitive-diagnosis tables.

statements.statement: Within the \(q\)-state double-triangular parameterization, \(\Delta_{\mathrm{DT}}\neq0\) if and only if \(\operatorname{rank}(M_1)=\operatorname{rank}(M_2)=q^K\). If \(d_{a,k,u}=0\), then view \(a\) is rank deficient. For \(q=3\), strictly positive local tables can have pairwise distinct conditional columns and \(d_{a,k,u}=0\).
statements.justification: This is an exact local algebraic frontier rather than a generic full-rank premise.
statements.gap: Allman, Matias, and Rhodes (2009) use global Kruskal inequalities, while Lee and Gu (2026) do not characterize the categorical zero boundary.
statements.consumer: It separates admissible but uncertified assessment designs from full-rank designs and identifies the failing context.

statements.statement: For every fixed categorical double-triangular graph \(\Gamma\) and latent DAG \(\Lambda\), \(\Delta_{\mathrm{DT}}\) is a rational function on \(\Theta_{\Gamma,\Lambda}^{+}\) with strictly positive denominators and a nonzero polynomial numerator \(N_{\mathrm{DT}}\). The diagonal-dominant family in Definition 5 belongs to \(\Theta_{\Gamma,\Lambda}^{+}\) and has \(d_{a,k,u}=\eta_{a,k,u}^{q-1}\). Hence \(\{\theta\in\Theta_{\Gamma,\Lambda}^{+}:\Delta_{\mathrm{DT}}(\theta)\neq0\}\) is nonempty, relatively open and dense, and its complement has Lebesgue measure zero in the affine product of simplex interiors.
statements.justification: An explicit interior family certifies that generic nonvanishing is substantive rather than an unsupported algebraic slogan.
statements.gap: Lee and Gu (2026, Appendix G) note a categorical determinant obstruction but do not exhibit a nonzero polynomial witness for every fixed double-triangular graph or derive relative openness and density.
statements.consumer: Designers may perturb a positive item bank away from the certificate boundary without changing its graph.

statements.statement: The proposed equal-alphabet certified class and \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{Chen}}\) are incomparable in the ambient mixed-type latent-structure universe. On \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{cert}}^{(q)}(K,J)\), every selected observed variable has support \(q\), so Chen et al.'s discrete sufficient-measurement requirement \( |\operatorname{supp}(X_j)|>|\operatorname{supp}(H_k)|\) fails when both supports equal \(q\); the dense ternary witness is therefore outside their two-sufficient-measurement class. Conversely, \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{Chen}}\) permits continuous measurements and graphs without two disjoint triangular views, so it is not contained in \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{cert}}^{(q)}(K,J)\). Completeness in Chen et al. supplies a discretization with full-rank tables, whereas this project derives full rank from the finite local certificate without assuming completeness or larger-support measurements.
statements.justification: The class relation prevents the new certificate from being presented as a disguised instance of completeness or two sufficient measurements.
statements.gap: Chen et al. (2025, Proposition 4.2, Definition D.3, and Theorem 4.19) cover mixed-type measurements through completeness and two sufficient measurements, not equal-state double-triangular tables.
statements.consumer: It tells practitioners whether a mixed-type tensor-rank guarantee or the local categorical certificate applies to a given item bank.

statements.statement: For every \((G,P)\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{cert}}^{(q)}(K,J)\), \(\operatorname{rank}(T_{12})=q^K\), and consequently \(K_{\min}(P_X)=K\) even when a competing realization with fewer \(q\)-state coordinates is not double triangular.
statements.justification: The latent dimension becomes a functional of the observed law rather than analyst input.
statements.gap: Lee and Gu (2026, Theorem 1) prove the binary rank exclusion; Kivva et al. (2021) obtain component orders from a mixture oracle.
statements.consumer: It selects the number of polytomous skills before model fitting.

statements.statement: Suppose \((G,P)\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{cert}}^{(q)}(K,J)\) and a three-view decomposition has recovered \(\mathscr L(P_X)\) and the component conditional columns up to one arbitrary permutation. The observable family \(\mathcal E(P_X)\), together with measurement nondegeneracy and the subset condition, determines a bijection \(\varphi_{\mathrm{coord}}:\mathscr L(P_X)\to\mathcal Q^K\) uniquely modulo \(\mathfrak G\). Transporting the recovered weights and conditional columns through this bijection identifies \(\Gamma,\pi,p\); faithfulness then identifies \([\Lambda]_{\mathrm{MEC}}\). Thus the passage from \(q^K\) anonymous mixture labels to \(K\) \(q\)-state coordinates and a latent MEC is an additional identification step not supplied by generic three-view Kruskal uniqueness.
statements.justification: Anonymous latent-class labels are insufficient for a causal measurement graph; the equality-pattern theorem supplies the missing coordinate product and MEC.
statements.gap: Allman, Matias, and Rhodes (2009) stop at label swapping for one \(q^K\)-class variable, while Kivva et al. (2021) obtain coordinate structure from a supplied mixture oracle; neither proves this observable coordinate-alignment result for certified categorical BLCMs.
statements.consumer: It lets an identifiability checker report named latent coordinates, their observed-child sets, and a latent MEC rather than an uninterpreted \(q^K\)-component mixture.

statements.statement: For every \((G,P)\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{cert}}^{(q)}(K,J)\), the observed law \(P_X\) first determines only the unstructured \(q^K\)-label set \(\mathscr L(P_X)\) through generic three-view uniqueness; the component-equality pattern \(\mathcal E(P_X)\) then uniquely aligns those labels with \(K\) \(q\)-state coordinates through \(\varphi_{\mathrm{coord}}\), modulo \(\mathfrak G\), and latent conditional independences determine \([\Lambda]_{\mathrm{MEC}}\). Consequently \(P_X\) uniquely determines \(\mathcal R(P_X)=[\Gamma,\pi,p,[\Lambda]_{\mathrm{MEC}}]_{\sim}\); equivalently, every realization in the fully enumerated domain \(\mathcal C_K(P_X)\) belongs to the same \(\sim\)-equivalence class.
statements.justification: The theorem separates generic mixture-label recovery from the new coordinate-alignment argument that identifies the measurement graph and latent MEC.
statements.gap: Lee and Gu (2026, Theorem 2) cover binary latents; Allman et al. (2009) identify an arbitrary latent-class label set but do not recover its \(K\)-coordinate product structure, measurement adjacency, or latent MEC.
statements.consumer: It certifies that a recovered polytomous skill graph and latent MEC are not artifacts of another same-dimension BLCM realization.

statements.statement: The explicitly dimensioned construction \((\Gamma^{\star},P^{\star})\) belongs to \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{cert}}^{(3)}(3,8)\). For every \(h\in\{0,1,2\}^3\), all conditional probabilities are strictly positive; the third latent coordinate has no pure child; and the displayed selected matrices satisfy \(\det(B_{a,k,u})=(c^{\star}_{s(a,k),\rho_a(k)})^2>0\). Thus \(\Delta_{\mathrm{DT}}>0\), the same properties persist on a relatively open neighborhood in the positive table space, and \(\mathcal R(P_X^{\star})\) is identified.
statements.justification: The witness demonstrates a positive no-pure-child ternary region and makes every certificate matrix inspectable.
statements.gap: Lee and Gu (2026) give binary no-pure-child examples and ternary failures, but no positive certified ternary model supporting the full chain.
statements.consumer: It is an exact regression test and simulation fixture for a \(\texttt{cdmTools}\)-style checker.

statements.statement: Let \(q_{\mathrm{bin}}=2\). On \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{LG},1}^{\mathrm{bin}}(K,J)\), whose assumptions are exactly the Lee--Gu measurement graph, Markov factorization, positive latent support, binary measurement nondegeneracy, and binary double triangularity, both \((M_{\mathrm{bin}})_1\) and \((M_{\mathrm{bin}})_2\) are nonsingular, \(\operatorname{rank}((T_{12})_{\mathrm{bin}})=2^K\), and \((K_{\min})_{\mathrm{bin}}((P_X)_{\mathrm{bin}})=K\), which are the full-rank and latent-dimension conclusions of Lee and Gu (2026, Theorem 1). On \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{LG},2}^{\mathrm{bin}}(K,J)\), adding exactly their faithfulness, third-view-coverage, and subset conditions identifies \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{bin}}((P_X)_{\mathrm{bin}})\) modulo binary coordinate and state relabeling and the latent MEC, which is their Theorem 2 conclusion.
statements.justification: The separately typed comparator records the exact binary assumptions and conclusions without specializing any categorical-domain symbol.
statements.gap: This is a fidelity and reduction proposition, not a categorical novelty claim; all novel determinant and alignment theorems remain scoped to the declared categorical domain.
statements.consumer: A unified checker can dispatch binary inputs to the published Lee--Gu certificate and categorical inputs to the local-minor certificate.

statements.statement: Can one derive from \(\mathsf H_q\) an explicit algorithm \(A_q\) that halts on every exact \(P_X\) after finitely many rank, reconstructed-minor, and conditional-independence queries; returns exactly \(\mathcal R(P_X)\) on \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{cert}}^{(q)}(K,J)\); retains only realizations of \(P_X\); represents every element of the fully specified domain \(\mathcal C_K(P_X)\); and proves termination with the stated lexicographic measure?
statements.justification: Identification without a terminating recovery map leaves the local certificate disconnected from exact diagnosis.
statements.gap: Gu (2026) requires two pure items per attribute, Kivva et al. (2021) assumes a mixture oracle, and Lee and Gu (2026) give a heuristic estimator rather than a complete population algorithm.
statements.consumer: A positive answer is the mathematical specification for a certified polytomous identifiability checker.

statements.statement: Can \(\widehat\Phi_n\) yield a multiplicity-calibrated test with asymptotically controlled familywise type-I error over rank-degenerate \(q\)-state models and acceptance probability tending uniformly to one when \(\min_{a,k,u}|d_{a,k,u}|\ge\kappa\) and \(\sigma_{q^K}(T_{12})\ge\kappa\) for fixed \(\kappa>0\)?
statements.justification: Population zero-versus-nonzero decisions need calibrated separation before deployment.
statements.gap: Gu et al. (2018) test provisional \(Q\)-matrix fit, while \(\texttt{cdmTools}\) checks binary structural criteria; neither handles adaptive categorical local-minor queries.
statements.consumer: The routine can extend \(\texttt{cdmTools::is.Qid}\) with multiplicity-adjusted uncertainty and a failing-minor trace.

sampling_model.design: Population identification from the exact observed law \(P_X\); the optional empirical rung observes \(n\) independent response vectors.
sampling_model.units: Independent respondents with common categorical response law \(P_X\) only in the empirical rung.
sampling_model.treatment: There is no designated treatment; the causal target is the latent measurement graph, latent law, and latent DAG Markov-equivalence class.
sampling_model.overlap: Every latent configuration has positive probability.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: No nuisance is estimated in the population results; empirical queried marginals use cell proportions.

estimand_functional: \(\mathcal R(P_X)=A_q(P_X)\), with \(A_q\) to be derived from \(\mathsf H_q\)

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: For binary latent variables, double triangularity yields full-rank views, identifies the latent dimension, and identifies the model under third-view and subset conditions.

Under completeness, nondegeneracy, two sufficient measurements, and the stated support condition, a mixed-type discrete latent structure and its latent MEC are identified by tensor-rank and discretization arguments.
Three finite latent-class views are generically identifiable up to label swapping when their Kruskal ranks meet the stated inequality.
Population tensor unfoldings constructively identify a \(Q\)-matrix when every latent attribute has at least two pure items.
A measurement graph and latent law can be reconstructed from a mixture oracle under no-twins, maximality, nondegeneracy, and subset conditions.
Binary restricted latent-class \(Q\)-matrices admit checkable strict and generic identifiability criteria.
Observable response restrictions yield calibrated goodness-of-fit tests for a provisional cognitive-diagnosis \(Q\)-matrix.

tldr: The field-tier contribution for \(q\ge3\) is an explicit product \(\Delta_{\mathrm{DT}}\) of context-specific \(q\times q\) determinants for a novel categorical double-triangular condition. The determinant identity gives the exact full-rank frontier, is nonzero on an explicitly constructed relatively open dense full-measure subset of every fixed positive categorical-table parameter space, yields \(K_{\min}(P_X)=K\), and supports same-\(K\) quotient identification over a fully enumerated BLCM comparison domain. The identification argument isolates a new observable coordinate-alignment step: generic three-view uniqueness returns \(q^K\) anonymous mixture labels, while component-equality patterns recover \(K\) \(q\)-state coordinates and the latent MEC. A dimensionally consistent positive \(q=3,K=3,J=8\) model displays all six certificate matrices and has no pure child for its third latent coordinate. A separately typed \(q_{\mathrm{bin}}=2\) comparator records exactly the assumptions and conclusions of Lee and Gu's binary Theorems 1--2. Chen et al.'s mixed-type completeness and two-sufficient-measurement class is formally incomparable and does not cover the equal-\(q\) witness. The open rung is a terminating sound-and-complete reconstruction algorithm and a calibrated \(\texttt{cdmTools}\)-style diagnostic.

project_justification.gap: Binary double triangularity uses scalar contrasts, whereas for \(q\ge3\) ordinary nondegeneracy permits a local conditional determinant to vanish. Generic Kruskal theory neither locates the failing graph context nor aligns its \(q^K\) anonymous mixture labels with \(K\) categorical coordinates and a latent MEC. Chen et al. (2025) restore tensor rank through completeness and two larger-support or continuous sufficient measurements, conditions that do not cover equal-\(q\) tables.
project_justification.niche: A novel categorical double-triangular graph condition exposes square local conditional tables; an explicit diagonal-dominant family shows their joint nonvanishing locus is open and dense inside the positive categorical-table space without completeness, pure children, or larger observed alphabets.
project_justification.fill: The project delivers a field-tier exact determinant frontier, an intrinsic latent-dimension theorem, an explicit coordinate-alignment theorem that upgrades anonymous \(q^K\) mixture labels to \(K\) categorical coordinates and a latent MEC, fixed-dimension quotient identification over an enumerated alternative domain, a dense positive ternary witness with displayed matrices, and a concrete recovery handle for CDM diagnostics.

related_work: Lee and Gu (2026, Theorems 1--2, Appendix D, and Appendix G) supply the binary proof template and isolate the categorical determinant obstruction. Their binary assumptions and conclusions are recorded in a separately typed \(q_{\mathrm{bin}}=2\) comparator; the categorical graph condition and local-minor certificate are distinct theorem objects restricted to \(q\ge3\). Chen et al. (2025, Proposition 4.2, Definition D.3, Theorem 4.19, and Remark D.11) identify mixed-type latent structures using completeness and two sufficient measurements; their discrete sufficient measurements have support strictly larger than the latent support, so their result does not contain the equal-\(q\) certified class, while their continuous and non-triangular models prevent reverse containment. Allman, Matias, and Rhodes (2009) provide three-view Kruskal uniqueness once two full-rank views are established, but that theorem returns one \(q^K\)-class variable only up to arbitrary label permutation; the component-equality theorem supplies the additional alignment into \(K\) \(q\)-state coordinates, measurement adjacency, and a latent MEC. Gu (2026) organizes constructive unfolding queries under two pure items per attribute. Kivva et al. (2021) separate graph, state-alignment, latent-law, and latent-DAG recovery while assuming a mixture oracle; their modular decomposition informs the coordinate-alignment target but does not furnish it from \(P_X\). Gu (2025) motivates explicit polynomial exceptional sets. Gu and Xu (2021) provide binary \(Q\)-matrix criteria used by current software, and Gu et al. (2018) provide the adjacent calibrated-testing template.
technical_internal_limitation: The population algorithm receives exact probabilities and may query exact ranks and determinants. Finite-sample soundness cannot follow by arbitrary thresholding; the empirical question therefore fixes a separation margin and a singular-intersection branch.
honest_scope: For \(q\ge3\), the determinant factorization, exact frontier, open-dense nonvanishing theorem, Chen-class noncoverage relation, intrinsic dimension, observable coordinate alignment, fixed-\(K\) quotient identification, and ternary witness are theorem targets. The separately declared \(q_{\mathrm{bin}}=2\) comparator records the published Lee--Gu binary full-rank, dimension, and identification conclusions on their own binary domains. A terminating sound-and-complete local-query algorithm and simultaneous sampling calibration remain open. Unequal latent cardinalities, observed alphabets smaller than \(q\), observed-to-observed edges, and identification beyond the latent MEC are outside scope.

novelty_justification: The field-tier kernel starts where Lee and Gu's binary scalar contrast fails: for \(q\ge3\), it defines a novel categorical double-triangular condition, factors each \(q^K\)-view determinant into every context-specific \(q\times q\) minor, and proves an iff boundary. The Lee--Gu reduction is kept in a separately typed \(q_{\mathrm{bin}}=2\) domain with its exact published assumptions and conclusions, so no categorical symbol is specialized outside its declared space. An explicit diagonal-dominant family makes the numerator polynomial visibly nonzero on each fixed positive-table parameter space, giving a genuine relatively open dense full-measure locus. Chen et al. (2025) are the closest mixed-type comparator, but their completeness route and two sufficient measurements do not cover equal observed and latent support \(q\); their class is formally incomparable because it also admits continuous and non-triangular models. Beyond generic three-view uniqueness, the component-equality pattern identifies the product-coordinate map from \(q^K\) anonymous labels to \(K\) \(q\)-state coordinates and then the latent MEC. The rank identity makes \(K\) intrinsic and feeds fixed-dimension quotient identification over an explicitly enumerated BLCM alternative domain. The algorithmic advance remains honestly open: derive a terminating local-query procedure without pure items, larger-support measurements, completeness, or a mixture oracle.
